info.name: FamilySearch API
info.description:
Postman collection for the **FamilySearch API** (Family Tree, Places, Dates, Memories, Sources, Discussions, Names, Vocabularies, Trees/Genealogies), generated from the 205 operations in the official OpenAPI reference at https://developers.familysearch.org/main/reference/api-reference-guide.

**Setup**
1. Register an app at https://www.familysearch.org/developers/ to get an App Key (client_id). Beta access is automatic; production requires the Compatible Solution Program.
2. Set client_id and redirect_uri (the one registered with your key).
3. Run folder 00 step 1 → sign in in a browser → paste the code into auth_code → run step 2. The token is saved to access_token and sent as Bearer on every request.

Or use Postman's built-in OAuth 2.0 (Authorization Code with PKCE) — authorize URL {{ident_base}}/oauth2/v3/authorization, token URL {{ident_base}}/oauth2/v3/token, client authentication 'Send client credentials in body', no secret.

**Environments**: Beta = apibeta / identbeta (sample data). Production = api.familysearch.org / ident.familysearch.org.

**Notes**: Historical *record* search (e.g. Ellis Island passenger lists) is not part of the public API reference; use the Family Tree record matches (hints) endpoints instead. Write operations send an X-Reason header ({{change_reason}}). Respect 429 throttling (Retry-After).

exec: if(pm.response.code===401) console.warn('401: run 00 · Authentication to get a fresh access_token');

request.description: Generates a PKCE verifier/challenge, then shows the FamilySearch sign-in URL. Open it in a browser, sign in, and copy the `code` from the redirect into the `auth_code` variable. Codes expire after 5 minutes and are single-use.

exec: // PKCE (S256): generate verifier + challenge, build the browser login URL
